root_cause.text: The `q->ndesc` field is initialized too early in `airoha_qdma_init_tx_queue()`, before the allocation of the `q->entry` array, so if the allocation fails, the cleanup function `airoha_qdma_cleanup_tx_queue()` dereferences a NULL pointer when iterating over the unallocated `entry` array using the prematurely set `ndesc` value.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `q->ndesc = size;` from the beginning of `airoha_qdma_init_tx_queue()` to after all allocations and initialization succeed (at the end of the function). The commit message explicitly states that early `ndesc` initialization causes the NULL pointer dereference upon allocation failure.

intent_record.intent_summary: Move assignment of q->ndesc after successful resource allocation to prevent stale descriptor count on initialization failure.
intent_record.what: Moved the assignment of `q->ndesc = size;` from before memory allocation and descriptor initialization to after successful completion of those operations, replacing `q->ndesc` with the local variable `size` in the allocation calls and loop.
intent_record.how: Ensures that `q->ndesc` is only set after all resources have been successfully allocated and initialized, preventing a non-zero value from persisting if the queue setup fails partway through.
